explication: Agent Squad is a multi-runtime framework for routing user queries to specialized AI agents while preserving conversation context. Its main workflow is query → intent classification → selected agent response → saved exchange. Python and TypeScript provide cloud-oriented agent and storage choices; Swift adds on-device orchestration, realtime voice, MCP tooling, and tracing. The README documents the shared workflow and major capabilities; source excerpts are incomplete, so links for unsampled subsystems are included only where documentation supports them.
